item.title: Fix window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Repository: fix-off-by-one (base main). Running `python3 -m unittest` currently fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes. Do NOT modify the tests. The fix must be correct for every input, not only the tested ones: read the function's contract from its code, tests and docstring, and handle edge cases (empty input, boundary indices, single elements, and so on) correctly. Keep the change minimal and readable; add no unnecessary comments. Run `python3 -m unittest` and confirm it passes before finishing. Commit the fix on the item's branch with a clear message; do not push.

Operator request, verbatim: "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py. sliding_windows built its comprehension over range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window. It now uses range(len(items) - size + 1). Empty input, size > len and size == len all behave correctly, and size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Checks: python3 -B -m unittest runs 3 tests, all OK; manual edge cases ([] size 1, [1] size 1, [1] size 2, [] size 3, [1,2,3] size 3, [1,2,3,4] size 2) match expectations. Committed as 3db51d0 on archon/e3j4v0j2-fix-window-py-so-python3-m-unittest-pass (tree 86fa257), not pushed, with no Co-Authored-By line. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M89XHAYP4Y7Q0N8ZKJ1X8C0D) passed the head with no findings. pr.body: Changed the loop bound in window.py from range(len(items) - size) to range(len(items) - size + 1). Empty result when size > len(items); size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Checks: python3 -m unittest passes (3 tests); edge cases checked manually. Tests unchanged. Assumes the documented contract: every contiguous window of size items, in order.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return every window, including the last. now: [1,2,3] size 2 -> [[1,2],[2,3]]. before: [[1,2]]
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window
